scene: The rooftop opens to a transit hub.
picture: A flat side view along a wide wooden rooftop terminal. On the far left, a sleek suspended monorail waits at a gantry. An elderly East Asian man in a blue flat cap, orange cardigan, holding a wooden cane stands on the left. In the centre sits a glass-domed funicular carriage. Far right, a brass rickshaw rests.
shown: a sleek suspended monorail car on an overhead rail, far left
a glass-domed funicular carriage waiting on angled tracks, centre
a two-wheeled brass rickshaw with a friendly toad driver, far right
